Results.ReviewText: This is the best small grill.  It does a great job.  Love that its compact, plenty of grill space, easy to use and clean and portable.
Results.Title: Great Little Grill

Results.ReviewText: This Weber Grill is just what I like in a small BBQ grill. It is easy to set up and cooks well. My one problem with it is that it does not heat well if there is a breeze over 5 mph. I solved that by simply moving it from my back patio to  my front patio. I like the fact that I do not have to change out a 35 pound propane tank any more.
Results.Title: A great buy!

Results.ReviewText: I am very happy with my grill, however, ran into a problem with the regulator valve which malfunctioned after 3 months. Customer service was very responsive and sent me a replacement which I have now installed and the grill is working fine. Now I will see if that continues with the new valve and hopefully won't have any further problems.
Results.Title: Regulator valve needed replacement

Results.ReviewText: I just bought my second Q1200. I have had one for 9 years and love it. It is used at home weekly and we take it on camping trips. We just purchased a new camper and bought a new grill to keep in my camper. Great grill and quality product.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Q1200, Weber portable grill, high quality material
Results.Title: Great grill, mighty for the price, Easy to clean!

Results.ReviewText: Cooks better than my weber Genesis, very surprised. Sears excellent, cooks great at low heat as well.
Results.Title: Weber 1200q

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill. Provides even heat and has more grilling space than you would think. It is perfect for apartment living since I have a very small patio.
Results.Title: The Q1200 may be small but it’s still a WEBER!

Results.ReviewText: My wife and I were introduced to the Weber Q while spending our North American winter in Australia.  Our rental had an older Weber Q on the patio and we used it regularly.  We also noticed that these little grills were very popular with campers and boaters.  After finding the Australian Cookbook for the Weber Q we decided to buy one as soon as we got home.  The unit heats up quickly and cooks food predictably.  We love it!
Results.Title: Perfect for Two!

Results.ReviewText: Why buy anything else, this little tailgate grill cooks like a big boy. Top quality grill you can’t go wrong.
Results.Title: Little tailgate grill cooks like a big grill

Results.ReviewText: Follow the directions , it is the best small gas grill I've ever used for one or two people
Results.Title: Best grill ever

Results.ReviewText: I bought this for our RV and we used it all long weekend.  Cooks evenly, and quickly, and is easy to clean.
Results.Title: Love the simplicity and sturdiness!

Results.ReviewText: Excellent little grill great for 2 people. Very portable, heats up quickly and very even heat across the entire grilling surface.
Results.Title: A Little Beauty!

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. It is very important to us, and we'll be sure to share this with the appropriate teams. We want to learn more about your grilling experience. Please look for an outreach email from our Care Team soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: Somewhat pricey for the quality of the lime green paint job ! Cooks ok nothing out of the ordinary.
Results.Title: Poor Paint Job

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber small grill. My first I got second hand, 10 years ago. These are, by far, the Q1200 is the best small grill I have seen, having thrown out several of the cheaper grills over 30 years.
Results.Title: Awesome Grill

Results.ReviewText: The grill functions well overall. The fold in work surface trays should have some kind of limiter to prevent them from contacting the cooking grates when stowed for transport or storage. It’s pretty lame that the grill comes with only 1 disposable grease drip pan and though I purchased it at a nationwide retailer (Cabela’s) they did not offer replacement pans for the grill.
Results.Title: Versatile small travel grill

Results.ReviewText: I like the way it cooks hot and easy to clean up with the an on the bottom.
Results.Title: Road grilling

Results.ReviewText: I love this little grill. The food taste like you’re cooking over a fire.
Results.Title: Love it

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grill for camping . Can sit on wheels or a table. Lights quickly and surface area bigger than you think. 8 burgers , 4 big steaks,or all your breakfast- pancakes, eggs n bacon - we cook every meal on this grill.
Results.Title: Best travel grill

Results.ReviewText: Works great, exceptional customer service. I learned a lot from the wonderful representative I spoke with on the phone.
Results.Title: First time grill owner, very pleased.

Results.ReviewText: The grill is lightweight but sturdy. It offers an even cook and the included grates are quality. I enjoy the built-in table tops. I have had to replace the regulator and the tube but this was after three years of ownership.
Results.Title: Good Grill; Remember to Keep Parts Serviced

Results.ReviewText: BEST customer service and all round attitude towards a resolve the issue. Thanks 😊
Results.Title: Fantastic Service

Results.ReviewText: Back of burner has a ring of fire around the burner tube.  Is a weld missing or poorly executed?
Results.Title: ring of fire

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Q1200, my first one rolled out the storage compartment of my Fifth wheel trailer. Needless to say, I liked it so much, I decided to get the same one again.
Results.Title: Q1200 is awesome!

Results.ReviewText: Ignition button is a little loose, but otherwise it is a great grill.
Results.Title: Weber for life - love these grills

Results.ReviewText: The Q1200 has been my choice for grills, easy cooking and easy cleaning.
Results.Title: Easy pesy
Results.UserNickname: Big O from down around TX

Results.ReviewText:
Purchased the Q1200 with the built in thermometer for our fifth wheel adventures. 
After many years of the gas version of the go anywhere grill, we upgraded to the flip up shelves and blue colored grill. 
Quality and portability were of paramount importance. We wanted it to last for many years. 
It has not disappointed. Easy set up and small storage footprint has made it ideal for our home away from home.
Results.Title: Quality and portable.

Results.ReviewText: This is a great little grill, the best portable I've ever had!  I tried the cheaper camping models and they don't last. They rust, the igniter quits, the regulator starts sticking, etc. I feel like this Q1200 is solid as a rock and will last for a long time and over many travels!
Results.Title: Best little grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grille, had a q200 grille which this one replaced it and love the fold out shelves!!
Results.Title: Q 1200 grille

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber 1200 grill. I still travel with my original, keeping it in the back of my truck for grilling during road trips. I will use the new one at home. Easy operation, convenient size, and the ability to grill anything I choose to makes a Weber 1200 the perfect grill for us.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: I have had my grill for 4 years or more.  It is awesome and I use it all the time.  It has always worked when I needed it.  I would consider myself a heavy user and 1 recommendation is to keep it reasonably clean for best performance.   Also, get a hose to attach a 20lb propane tank and you will have this grill for years
Results.Title: Excellent grill

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We are really sorry to hear about the low gas flow on your Q1200 grill. Our Care team is here to help. We would like to do some troubleshooting with you. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: The regulator quit working right after the warranty expired.  And Weber would not send me a new one.  The unit overall has had very little use.  I paid almost 300$ for it and now have to pay over 50$ just for a new regulator.  What a joke.
Results.Title: Regulator died right after warranty expired.

Results.ReviewText: Never been so happy with a grill. Should have gotten a long time ago. Best and most satisfying meals we've ever had have come off our new Weber 1200.
Results.Title: Would recommend the Weber 1200 to all.

Results.ReviewText: I really like the internal flame grate relationship. It's hard to burn food on this grill.  I have had a couple Weber 22 inch, and a Weber natural gas grill. These were all good grills but now I don't need the large grills anymore and this Q 1200 fits my lifestyle better.
Results.Title: Better than I thought. Surprisingly pleased. Looks

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback and are sorry to hear about your disappointing experience. Your satisfaction is our top priority, and we want to make this right for you. Please look for an outreach email from our Care Team soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: Could not get temp below 400. Local Ace needed your approval to repair. Called Weber, said it was probably the regulator. Said he was sending a NEW ONE. I thought he meant grille. I received a regulator with 4 pages of instructions on how to replace. I am not a mechanic. Ace sent someone to install. Weber sucks at customer support. My last was a large grill that rusted in 1.5 years. Again ACE stood up when you did not!
Results.Title: Weber Customer Support is Non-Existent

Results.ReviewText: Though I’ve only used a few times I appreciate the temperature options and that it holds the set temp. Still much to learn as I go forward but this model is easy to clean and acts like a little outdoor oven.
Results.Title: Easy to Cook on

Results.ReviewText: Loving this grill, it’s the perfect size and cooks great!
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: We still have our old one that we use at our yearly party on our property.  The new one will stay at the house.  These have been the best grills we have ever used.
Results.Title: The best!

Photos.Caption: Completed Grill with Cart. Easy to assemble!

Results.ReviewText: This cute little grill was just what I needed to enhance my outdoor life. It is compact and convenient to travel with. I purchased a cart on wheels that also collapses so I can take it anywhere needed like a little carryon suitcase! I only purchase Weber for my grilling needs and am thrilled! Thank you Weber for such wonderful products.
Results.Title: Awesome Compact Grill

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to learn that your grill's cradle has melted repeatedly. That is not the experience we expect!

Our grills are composed of heat-proof materials that should not melt when exposed to high grilling temperatures. With regular cleaning and proper use, the grill should never normally reach a temperature hot enough to melt any part of the grill.

We would like to offer our assistance and learn more about your experience. Please look for an email from our Care team. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText:
It grills perfectly. It has the same foibles as any grille as in the parts need to be replaced periodically. 

The size, design and how it grilles is what distinguishes it from others. 

I’m on my second 1200. Twice the plastic frame that holds the aluminum shell in place has melted causing the shell to melt and tilt badly to one side. This prevents the top from closing with the shelves folded in. It’s hard to believe Weber doesn’t know this grille does this. 

Anyway I bought my third one at 50% off bc I like the way it grilles. Weber if you can fix this melting problem you would have the perfect grille!!
Results.Title: Love it. Hate it.

Results.ReviewText: Perfect for two people in a camper. Heats up fast and easily controls and holds heat. Also purchased heavier constructed bag … great quality! Grill folds up and goes in easily. Grates removes and another “easy” fits in sink/dishwasher for quick clean up. Now wondering if there is a griddle top. Going to ck that out!
Results.Title: a beefy little grill.

Results.ReviewText: One of the best portable grills out. You cannot go wrong with the Q1200.
Results.Title: Small but powerful

Results.ReviewText: Purchased for camper and converted to quick detach.  I would have thought there would have been more information from Weber on this.  Found info on Youtube.  Grill takes a while to warm up but will work just fine.  Have not grilled yet but impressed with quality so far.
Results.Title: 1200Q

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback and will be sure to share this with the appropriate teams. Our Care team is here to help and will be sure to follow up with you. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Ok love the size but not the heat consistency.  This is my second Q1200 and overall I’m ok with it I just wish it had better heat tubes that did not plug and easier to clean.  Could be improved in design
Results.Title: Mixed feelings

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill 4 years ago. I had a problem with it that was resolved thanks to the Weber Social Care and Review Specialist.
Results.Title: Great for patio grilling

Results.ReviewText: This grill’s regulator stopped working after only several uses. Very disappointing.
Results.Title: Regulator broke after only several uses

Results.ReviewText: Great portable gas grill. I'm usually a charcoal guy, but this is great for when speed and simplicity is what you want.
Results.Title: Great portable gas grill!
